abstract: Background: Much of the enthusiasm for vibe coding rests on two intuitive beliefs: (1) that developers stay invested even when they no longer write the code, and (2) that delegating more of the work to AI lowers their cognitive load. Objective: Our goal was to investigate whether developers' neurophysiological states and interactions with AI are consistent with these beliefs when they work with agentic vs. non-agentic AI on their own project vs. a legacy codebase.   Method: We conducted an exploratory within-subjects crossover study with 11 participants across 22 sessions. Each participant used GitHub Copilot Chat in one session and Cursor Agents in the other, working on their own project and a legacy codebase, with tool-codebase pairings randomly assigned and session order counterbalanced. We recorded participants' EEG, on-screen activity, and prompts, and analyzed 7,924 EEG data points, 984 activities, and 141 prompts.   Results: Our findings contradict both beliefs. With the agent, participants remained indifferent to task outcomes, even on their own projects, and cognitive load was higher than with non-agentic AI. Furthermore, their ways of interacting shifted: with non-agentic AI, participants asked how the code worked and read it to verify changes; with the agent, they described desired app behavior and checked results in the running app.   Conclusion: Our study reveals a vibe paradox: delegating to an agent left participants motivationally disinterested, even on their own projects, without relieving cognitive load, while coinciding with increased trust in AI. The community should treat this paradox as a first-class concern if developers and their AI agents are to go far together, and not just fast.

ob.ai_reason: 研究代理式AI下开发者认知负荷，属边缘
ob.tldr: 考察代理式AI编码是否让开发者更投入并减轻认知负担。11名开发者完成22次被试内交叉实验，结合EEG、屏幕活动与提示词，比较代理式与非代理式AI及自有和遗留代码库。代理式AI反而提高认知负荷、削弱任务结果投入；互动由追问和核查代码转向描述行为并测试运行结果。

ur.ai_reason: 开发者脑电实验，比较两类智能体
ur.tldr: 11名开发者在22次会话中分别使用GitHub Copilot Chat与Cursor Agents，并同步记录EEG、屏幕活动和提示。智能体编码反而提高认知负荷、削弱任务投入；交互从阅读和追问代码转向描述产品行为并验收结果，揭示“委托越多、投入越低”的氛围编程悖论。

title: The Vibe Paradox: What EEG Reveals About Your Brain When Vibe Coding
title_zh: 氛围编程悖论：EEG 揭示的大脑活动
